limitations.quote: // The final 0 of a match is also the start of a new prefix.
limitations.note: The switch to `nstate` fixed the one-cycle match delay, but the patch also changed what happens after a match: a valid `1` or an invalid cycle now carries a prefix forward instead of returning to idle.
The test oracle assumed a rolling window of valid bits, so it treated the added overlapping matches as correct instead of checking that the original post-match behavior was preserved.
The test harness had to be resubmitted twice before it ran: first because the cleanup command was rejected, then because the retry used an unavailable Python executable.
